prompt: A warm painted animated film in the same elegant olive-green restaurant kitchen. One continuous locked-off medium shot. Preserve the characters, faces, adult proportions, clothing, warm lighting, painted texture and fixed kitchen from the reference. Natural restrained human motion at normal speed. Stable solid objects with clearly separated hands and surfaces. The chef holds the baking tray securely with the folded cloth. She gently slides the tray along the visible rack into the open oven. Once the tray is fully supported by the rack, she releases the tray, draws both hands and the cloth back together through the open doorway, and pauses. The oven, door, rack and tray remain solid and rigid. The tartlets remain on the tray.
